description: Evaluation dataset (generation 1, migrated) for AskWRI Cite mode. Migrated 2026-08-12 from source_evalsets/cite-golden-dataset.json (v3.0, frozen reference covering the original 169-document corpus) into the generation-2+ schema (parallel expected_external_ids/expected_document_ids arrays) used by evalsets/evalset_cite_02.json. This migration is schema-only: expected_document_ids (UUIDs) are left as empty-string placeholders, since resolving them requires the documents-list-207 lookup, and the corpus is expected to change again shortly. No catalog revalidation, re-search, or doc re-addition was performed this round -- expected_external_ids are carried over exactly as they were in cite-golden-dataset.json (i.e. already reflecting that source's prior 'not in catalog' prunings from the 169-doc-corpus era). A follow-up pass, once the corpus is finalized, should: (1) resolve expected_document_ids via documents-list-207_*.txt, (2) re-check previously-pruned candidates against the current/final catalog (at least 7 were already confirmed back in catalog as of 2026-08-12: rolling-out-electric-buses, access-to-climate-finance, assessing-financing-challenges, changing-the-demand-preference, financial-analysis-of-charging-station-fact, seizing-the-urban-opportunity, improving-school-infrastructure-for-healthier -- see git history / prior chat log for details), and (3) consider whether any topics now have new zh/es/pt counterparts among the 26 recently-added documents. source_evalsets/cite-golden-dataset.json remains the frozen, untouched original reference.

test_cases.question: What have we published on land value capture?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve for papers that take land value capture (a sub-topic of urban planning) as their primary focus. Do not retrieve papers that only mention thematic area – e.g. papers where those words show up in literature review, mentioned in discussion section, etc.
test_cases.note: query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'topic_area' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'topic_discovery' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: What have we published on Bangalore?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about a specific geography as their primary focus. Do not retrieve papers that only mention geography tangentially.
test_cases.note: query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'geography' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'geography_constrained' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: What have we published on children and pollution?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about a thematic intersection as their primary focus. Do not retrieve papers that only mention one or the other tangentially.
test_cases.note: query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'thematic_intersection' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'thematic_intersection' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: What have we published on climate adaptation in Brazil?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about a thematic and geographical intersection as their primary focus. Do not retrieve papers that only mention one or the other tangentially.
test_cases.note: query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'thematic_geographic_intersection' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'geography_constrained' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: How can cities implement micromobility solutions?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about a not well-defined topic area (micromobility encompasses a range of technologies). Do not retrieve papers that clearly are about non 'micro', such as public transit, freight, and other non-mobility solutions.
test_cases.note: Removed enabling-shift-electric-auto-rickshaws (not in catalog). query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'fuzzy_topic' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'topic_discovery' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: Will electrifying school buses be beneficial for children's health outcomes?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about the impact of an intervention on a population? Do not retrieve papers that are about the intervention (school bus electrification) without talking about the specific impact of interest.
test_cases.note: ImpactAr tool covers health impacts of bus fleet electrification, though not school buses specifically. query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'intervention_impact' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'thematic_intersection' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: What can be done to solve the housing crisis in Jakarta?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers that are about solutions to a general thematic problem area within a determined geography. Do not retrieve papers that only cover theme or geography, and only retrieve papers that talk about solutions.
test_cases.note: Updated from negative test (0 expected) to include adjacent/related docs per user guidance. Surabaya is other Indonesia city, rest are global scope housing solutions. query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'solution_focused' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'topic_discovery' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: Have we published any papers or reports on hydrogen?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve papers about a niche topic. Do not retrieve papers that talk about broader energy/mobility topics and just tangentially mention the technology.
test_cases.note: First 2 are directly on hydrogen, last 2 include hydrogen in energy analysis. Removed completing-trip (not in catalog). query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'niche_technology' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'topic_discovery' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: Give me all the papers that were published as part of the cities World Resources Report?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve all papers that were published within a specific, well-defined research program, our WRI Ross Center's flagship research initiative that ran roughly 2015-2021. Do not retrieve papers that cite the WRR or have similar topics but were not part of the official corpus.
test_cases.note: 16 papers total: 2 framing/synthesis, 7 thematic, 7 city case studies. query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'umbrella_program' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'membership' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: Have we published anything to do with urban finance since 2020?
test_cases.task_description: Retrieve all papers that were published after a specific date on an amorphous intersection. 'Urban finance' is a concatenation of two amorphous terms and not thing as such, so expecting to return all things in our corpus to do with finance, which is mostly electric buses and transportation.
test_cases.note: Date filter: 2020 onwards. Removed 5 docs not in catalog: rolling-out-electric-buses, access-climate-finance, assessing-financing-challenges, changing-demand-preference, financial-analysis-charging-station-fact. query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'amorphous_temporal' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'date_constrained' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

test_cases.question: Have we published anything to do with urban finance – please exclude anything to do with electric buses?
test_cases.task_description: Variation on the previous question, asking to remove the dominant thematic intersection and removing the temporal cut off.
test_cases.note: Urban finance minus electric buses. Removed seizing-the-urban-opportunity (not in catalog). 2026-07-22: removed 4 electric-bus expected_urls that contradicted the query's own exclusion clause (financing-electric-and-hybrid-electric-buses, assessing-financing-challenges-implementing-large-scale-electric-bus-program-india, rolling-out-electric-buses, the-future-of-urban-mobility-electric-bus-deployment-in-bogota-colombia). query_type migrated 2026-08-12 from original 'amorphous_exclusion' (cite-golden-dataset.json taxonomy) to 'topic_exclusion' (evalset_cite_02.json taxonomy).

metadata.note: 11 expected docs removed from original 72 (not in catalog). URL typo fixed: healthier-students-and-communities → healthier-communities. Pruned 3 more URLs missing from current corpus: improving-school-infrastructure-healthier-communities (q3, q6), Pathways-to-Decarbonize-the-Road-Transport-Sector-in-Guangdong (q8)
changes_from_v2: Ambiguous matches were all added, for human review, increasing the expected number of documents at least temporarily.

expected_document_ids uses documents.external_id, the same identifier the search service returns as doc_id (see search-service/app/pg_store.py — document_chunks.node_metadata.doc_id is populated from documents.external_id at ingest). Ambiguous urls (matching >1 document — confirmed duplicate ingests with identical url/date/title, different external_id suffix) include ALL candidate external_ids so recall isn't undercounted
changes_from_v1: Fixed Q6 expected_count (was 4 with note about null URL, now 4 with ImpactAr tool added)
Updated Q7 from negative test (0 expected) to include 4 related docs
Added Q9: World Resources Report (umbrella program, 16 papers)
Added Q10: Urban finance since 2020 (amorphous + temporal)
Added Q11: Urban finance excluding e-buses (amorphous + exclusion)
Skipped Q12: Major flagship publications (4 URLs missing from catalog)
metadata.query_type_migration_note: Original 11 cite-golden-dataset.json query_types were mapped onto evalset_cite_02.json's taxonomy on 2026-08-12: topic_area/fuzzy_topic/niche_technology/solution_focused all collapsed into topic_discovery (same relevance mechanic; fuzziness/niche-ness/solution-framing are topic-definition nuances, not independent constraint axes); geography/thematic_geographic_intersection collapsed into geography_constrained; amorphous_temporal renamed date_constrained. Three genuinely new axes were added to the shared taxonomy: thematic_intersection (topic x topic co-occurrence), membership (retrieval by named series/partnership/collaboration membership, broadened from the narrower 'umbrella_program' -- e.g. 'documents WRI wrote in partnership with X', not just report series), and topic_exclusion (renamed from amorphous_exclusion, 'X but exclude Y'). See query_expansion_plan_citemode_20260812.md for the full taxonomy table.
